visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with dark hair tied back in a bun stands in a dimly lit living room, wearing a yellow-and-white striped short-sleeved shirt. She looks directly into the camera lens with a smiling expression, gesturing with her hands while a brown wooden coffee table and a neutral-toned sofa are visible in the background. (2) A split-screen montage appears, showing close-up shots of her facial skin in 2014 with noticeable redness and acne compared to a smooth, clear complexion in 2024. She uses her index finger to point at her cheek, emphasizing the texture of her skin under bright, even lighting. (3) The setting shifts to a bathroom where the woman is seen leaning over a sink, splashing water on her face. Her hair is pulled up tightly as she rinses her skin. Then, she returns to the living room to hold up a glass of lemon juice and demonstrates squeezing a lemon into a bottle. (4) Various digital screen captures of articles and text-heavy social media posts are shown as overlays, discussing diet and skin health. The woman points at these overlays to highlight specific information while maintaining a friendly and communicative facial expression in the corner of the frame. (5) She demonstrates her skincare routine, showing a jar of pink, heart-shaped capsules and applying clear oil from one onto her hand and then her face. The lighting is bright and focused on the products, highlighting their textures and the shine they leave on her skin during application. (6) The woman applies a thin, translucent sheet mask to her face, smoothing it out with her fingers to ensure even contact. Several shots of different mask packaging are shown against a forest background, featuring green trees and natural lighting to emphasize a botanical or natural product theme. (7) She sits on the floor near a light-colored sofa and holds up a large, patterned gray pillow, demonstrating how facial skin comes into contact with the fabric during sleep. She mimics resting her head on the pillow, showing a side view of her face pressed against the textile surface. (8) In the final phase, she stands up and performs a short, energetic dance move, waving her hands and smiling widely toward the camera. The background remains the living room setting, and she eventually bends down toward the camera to conclude the recording with a playful gesture.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to share the creator's personal journey of transforming her skin from acne-prone to clear over a ten-year period. By listing four specific lifestyle and skincare habits, she provides actionable advice while subtly promoting 'anniuya' brand products through detailed demonstrations and a group-buy announcement.
